rules: Earthquake magnitude 7.0 or more (USGS), event within 24 h: CRITICAL
NWS tsunami bulletin of category Warning: CRITICAL; Watch or Advisory: notice
Planetary Kp 8 or more (NOAA G4+), value within 6 h: CRITICAL; Kp 7: notice
Earthquake magnitude 6.5 or more with the USGS tsunami flag: notice
